evidence.summary: Teams publish open slots and customers book them.
Recurring bookings: the same slot every week for up to 12 weeks.
Calendar sync keeps bookings in step with your calendar; details are in calendar.md.
The linked calendar.md is not among the provided docs, so how calendar sync works (providers, direction, conflicts) could not be read.
Waiting list: join a waiting list when a slot is full.
POST /bookings: 'Create a booking (optionally recurring)'; no request, response, auth or error schema given.
POST /waitlist: 'Join a waiting list'; no schema, auth or errors given.
The spec lists only two POST paths: no slot publishing, cancellation, listing or calendar endpoints are published, so their contracts are inferred or unknown.
